_doc: Settings for scripts/warning_checks.py. tunables: numeric literals in hh-core rule code that are not in allowed_literals, in an exempt file, or listed in exceptions are reported. Every exception says why.

exempt_files.crates/hh-core/src/rng.rs: ChaCha seed widths and hex parsing
exempt_files.crates/hh-core/src/driver.rs: the golden game's fixed seed, length and policy, and the script's build order

exceptions.why: a definition, not a tunable: a half-life halves, so the gap's daily factor is (1/2)^(1 / half_life_days)
a unit, not a tunable: the percent reading of a program condition is amount / cap x 100
display only: `short` shows a number to two decimal places (event texts' {rate}, project texts)
windows(2): each adjacent pair of phase days
windows(2) (adjacent tier bounds); lattice gradients in -2..=2 make one 1D gradient-noise octave span about -1..=1
the width of the -2..=2 gradient range
quintic fade polynomial 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3 (math, not a tunable)
quintic fade polynomial 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3 (math, not a tunable)
quintic fade polynomial 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3 (math, not a tunable)
the debug boost's largest factor (an overflow guard on a cheat, not a rule of play)
the debug cheat building's daily amount (Matt's 058 spec; a cheat, not a rule of play)
